name: cdp-bridge-mcp
description: MCP + CLI edition of cdp-bridge for OpenAI Codex: exposes 18 structured UTF-8 MCP browser tools (including mouse drag and pause/resume/concat WebM screen recording) over the shared cdp-bridge daemon (ideal for native Windows PowerShell/CMD and sandboxed sessions), plus workflow skill and PreToolUse guard hook.

interface.shortDescription: Structured MCP browser tools + persistent CDP bridge for Codex (ideal on Windows)
interface.longDescription: Exposes 18 zero-dependency Stdio MCP tools (cdp_pages, cdp_elements, cdp_click, cdp_fill, cdp_hover, cdp_drag, cdp_scroll, cdp_wait, cdp_screenshot, cdp_record, cdp_logs, cdp_network, cdp_batch, cdp_eval, cdp_call, etc.) backed by the shared cdp-bridge daemon over Windows Named Pipe or Linux Unix Socket. Eliminates PowerShell quoting and CP936 encoding issues while keeping single-handshake browser auth across windows.
capabilities: 18 structured UTF-8 MCP tools with readOnlyHint annotations, mouse drag, and WebM pause/resume/concat recording
Shared single-handshake connection over Windows Named Pipe or Linux Unix Socket
Zero PowerShell quoting or CP936/GBK encoding issues on native Windows
Top-Layer visual ghost cursor and click-only human takeover
PreToolUse Bash guard blocking raw 127.0.0.1:9222 bypasses
